facts: About 246,000 people (2022 census), roughly a tenth of Botswana
Within 15 km of the South African border
worth_knowing: Named after Chief Gaborone of the Tlokwa people. It was planned as the capital in the mid-1960s because it had no tie to any one indigenous group and was close to fresh water.
